title: Pythagorean Theorem
preview: The Pythagorean theorem and its converse, distance on the coordinate plane, and real-world applications.
description: Students apply the Pythagorean theorem to find unknown side lengths, use the converse to classify triangles, and compute distances between coordinate points.

sections.label: 7-1 The Pythagorean Theorem
sections.description: Find an unknown leg or hypotenuse; identify Pythagorean triples.

sections.label: 7-2 The Converse of the Pythagorean Theorem
sections.description: Use side lengths to test whether a triangle is right, acute, or obtuse.

sections.label: 7-3 Distance in the Coordinate Plane
sections.description: Apply the Pythagorean theorem to compute distances between points.

sections.label: 7-4 Real-World Applications
sections.description: Apply the Pythagorean theorem to design and measurement problems.
